messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: smart-routing-alert - high error rate and elevated latency for canary rollout v2 -> v3, affected region: eu-west-1. Pager level: P1. Assigning to oncall.
Alex K: I'm on it. seeing increased 500s from the canary pool, looks like model variant v3-quant may be failing under certain seq lengths.
Alex K: logs show KV cache misses spike + OOM logs on a subset of hosts:
```
2026-03-15T10:05:12Z host-12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (infer_srv)
2026-03-15T10:05:13Z infer_srv[1234]: Failed to allocate kv_cache size=1.2G
```
Maria P: Is traffic being routed away to other regions because of fallback policy? that could explain oscillation.
Chen Li: Yes, smart-router detected fail and kicked traffic to eu-central-1, but sticky-routing keys were preserved so many sessions kept coming back to the failing pool -> oscillation.
Jordan (oncall): Confirmed 503/500 downstream to several customers in EU, some SG enterprise accounts report degraded responses. Customer impact: ~2% of requests failing, latency 2-3x for rerouted sessions.
Alex K: I'm going to pause the canary rollout and pin canary traffic to v2. Running command to change rollout state now.
Alex K: `redwood rollout pause --id rollout-v3-canary --reason "canary OOMs in eu-west-1"`
ops-bot: rollout rollout-v3-canary state=PAUSED by alex.k at 2026-03-15T10:08:05Z
Maria P: Good. Next we need to clear sticky fallbacks for sessions that were bouncing. If sticky cookie is forcing clients back, we should expire sticky keys for eu-west-1 pools.
Chen Li: Agreed. I can run a targeted sticky-key flush for the canary group. Will target keys with prefix: `sticky:canary:v3:eu-west-1`.
Chen Li: Running: `redis-cli -h sticky-store scan 0 MATCH "sticky:canary:v3:eu-west-1*" | xargs -r redis-cli -h sticky-store del`
Alex K: Before clearing, we should notify SRE and customers that a manual sticky reset will temporarily route sessions. Jordan, can you post a status update to the affected customers channel?
Jordan (oncall): On it. Posting to #customer-impact-eu and #support. Also adding an SLA note.
Jordan (oncall): Message sent: "We've paused the v3 canary rollout and are clearing session sticky keys to stop regional oscillation. Expect transient route changes for affected sessions. Engineers on it, pushing updates shortly." :white_check_mark:
Tamika S: Quick question — did the autoscaler spin up any fallback cold pools with incompatible model variants? saw logs referencing fallback variant v2-small which lacks KV cache optimizations.
Alex K: Yes, fallback policy routed to v2-small in eu-central-1 for capacity. That variant doesn't support our new KV cache prefetch, so some requests errored. That's the "wrong model variant" part.
Maria P: We'll need to update the fallback policy to prefer compatible variants (v2-compat) or a degraded but compatible path instead of v2-small. Filing a policy change ticket.
Maria P: `TASK: INF-7224 update smart-routing fallback preference order; test in staging` assigned to Chen and Alex.
Chen Li: Sticky keys cleared. Running small smoke test against a subset of sessions.
Chen Li: Smoke test results: 200/200 ok for rerouted sessions, latency back to baseline for tested paths.
Jordan (oncall): Customer reports still see some errors but much lower. Support triage is verifying impacted requests. Will keep customers updated.
Alex K: Next steps: rollback any host-level changes, add a temporary rule to prevent routing back to the failing eu-west-1 canary pool until we fix OOM.
Alex K: `smart-router set-policy --scope eu-west-1 --canary-route allow=false --ttl 3600`
ops-bot: policy update applied by alex.k at 2026-03-15T10:20:12Z
Tamika S: Also increase observability: enable debug trace for smart-router decisions for the next hour.
Chen Li: Done. `orchestrator set-log-level smart-router DEBUG --duration 1h`
Maria P: I'm scheduling a controlled redeploy of v3 with reduced KV cache allocation and memory guardrails. We'll test with a small synthetic load first.
Alex K: For mitigation timeline: Pause rollout (done), clear sticky keys (done), apply routing block (done), smoke test (green). Next: model config change + canary redeploy targeted to non-eu hosts or with memory fix.
Jordan (oncall): Handing off to daytime oncall in 25m — Jordan -> Alex handoff for follow-up. I'll post an incident summary and update the incident channel.
Jordan (oncall): Incident summary posted to #incidents with links to logs and tickets. Notifying exec oncall.
Incident Bot: Incident created INC-20260315-0957 severity=P1. Current status: Mitigated (partial). Next update in 30m or on-change.
Alex K: Thanks everyone. If anything regresses ping me directly. I'll coordinate the canary config change and roll back if needed. :thumbsup:
Maria P: Filing a retro to capture the fallback policy hole and sticky-key semantics. We should add an automated guard: do not fallback to variants lacking required features.
Chen Li: Will include integration test to assert compatibility matrix for fallback variants.
Jordan (oncall): Closing loop for now. Reassigning incident to INF-7224 for follow-up actions. Will reopen if customer errors spike again.
Alex K: Closing thread here. Will post final postmortem timeline once INF-7224 has remediation steps."
